quality_scale.high: Official documentation/guidance, government guidance, or peer-reviewed/benchmark source with direct relevance.
quality_scale.medium: Credible technical documentation or preprint used with caution and corroborated by other sources.

sources.title: Designing AI agents to resist prompt injection
sources.why_it_matters: Current operational guidance on prompt injection as social engineering, source-sink analysis, and action confirmation/blocking patterns.

sources.title: Prompt injection is not SQL injection (it may be worse)
sources.why_it_matters: Strong framing that LLMs do not enforce a security boundary between instructions and data; logging and threat-modeling guidance.

sources.title: Architecting Security for Agentic Capabilities in Chrome
sources.why_it_matters: Documents User Alignment Critic, read-only/read-write origin sets, and deterministic URL/origin checks for agentic browsing.

sources.title: Mitigating the risk of prompt injections in browser use
sources.why_it_matters: Directly addresses browser-agent threat surfaces including webpages, embedded documents, ads, and dynamic scripts.

sources.title: How Microsoft defends against indirect prompt injection attacks
sources.why_it_matters: Production defense guidance including Spotlighting and layered mitigations for indirect prompt injection.

sources.title: LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
sources.why_it_matters: Comprehensive taxonomy of prompt injection patterns and baseline mitigations.

sources.title: Technical Blog: Strengthening AI Agent Hijacking Evaluations
sources.why_it_matters: Evaluation guidance: adaptive attacks, task-specific analysis, and multi-attempt testing are necessary for realistic risk estimates.

sources.title: CAISI Issues Request for Information About Securing AI Agent Systems
sources.why_it_matters: Distinguishes key agent risks including indirect prompt injection, data/model poisoning, and harmful actions absent adversarial input.

sources.title: Security Best Practices
sources.why_it_matters: Official MCP security guidance covering token passthrough, SSRF, session hijacking, local server compromise, and scope minimization.

sources.title: A Practical Guide for Secure MCP Server Development
sources.why_it_matters: Operational guidance for MCP server architecture, authentication, authorization, validation, session isolation, and hardened deployment.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026
sources.why_it_matters: Peer-reviewed, community-driven taxonomy covering goal hijack, tool misuse, supply chain, code execution, and memory/context poisoning.

sources.title: OWASP Agent Memory Guard
sources.why_it_matters: Concrete open-source design for defending memory poisoning with integrity checks, policy enforcement, snapshots, and rollback.

sources.title: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails Library Developer Guide
sources.why_it_matters: Documents programmable guardrails, including input, retrieval, dialog, execution, and output rails.

sources.title: Validators
sources.why_it_matters: Shows an output/input validation model focused on validators and metadata-driven checks.

sources.title: About LlamaFirewall
sources.why_it_matters: Documents scanner-based, layered defenses across user input, agent reasoning, and generated code.

sources.title: OpenGuardrails Documentation
sources.why_it_matters: Shows gateway/API-mode security posture, data leak prevention, and knowledge-base response patterns.

sources.title: BrowserGym
sources.why_it_matters: A maintained benchmark ecosystem for web task automation that is useful for regression and adversarial evaluation.

sources.title: AgentDojo Benchmark
sources.why_it_matters: Provides benchmark APIs with utility and security results for injection-aware agent evaluation.

sources.title: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design
sources.why_it_matters: Introduces CaMeL: explicit control/data-flow separation and capability enforcement for prompt-injection-resistant agents.

sources.title: ACE: A Security Architecture for LLM-Integrated App Systems
sources.why_it_matters: System-security architecture with abstract planning on trusted info, static analysis, and data/capability barriers.

sources.title: Prompt Injection Attack to Tool Selection in LLM Agents
sources.why_it_matters: Shows malicious tool documents can subvert tool selection and that common defenses can be insufficient.

sources.title: ObliInjection: Order-Oblivious Prompt Injection Attack to LLM Agents with Multi-source Data
sources.why_it_matters: Demonstrates successful multi-source injection when only a small portion of segments are attacker-controlled.

sources.title: TopicAttack: An Indirect Prompt Injection Attack via Topic Transition
sources.why_it_matters: Documents a social-engineering-style topic-transition attack that maintains plausibility while increasing success.

sources.title: Can Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks Be Detected and Removed?
sources.why_it_matters: Shows detection and removal are possible but should be treated as one layer, not a complete guarantee.

sources.title: Defending against Indirect Prompt Injection by Instruction Detection
sources.why_it_matters: Intermediate-state instruction detection offers a promising detector layer for indirect prompt injection.

sources.title: One Shot Dominance: Knowledge Poisoning Attack on Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
sources.why_it_matters: Shows single-document knowledge poisoning can be effective in RAG systems.

sources.title: RevPRAG: Revealing Poisoning Attacks in Retrieval-Augmented Generation through LLM Activation Analysis
sources.why_it_matters: Demonstrates a promising activation-based detector for poisoned RAG responses.

sources.title: Adaptive Attacks Break Defenses Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks on LLM Agents
sources.why_it_matters: Supports the need for adaptive testing because fixed defenses can break under tailored attacks.

sources.title: LLM02: Insecure Output Handling
sources.why_it_matters: Grounds output validation, downstream sink controls, and zero-trust handling of model outputs.

sources.title: Agentic AI: Emerging Threats, Mitigations, and Challenges
sources.why_it_matters: Useful supporting taxonomy for memory and context poisoning in agentic systems.
